title: Reminders, off
note: One switch and one plain line: a gentle nudge a few evenings a week, never late at night. Nothing is asked of the phone until the switch is turned on.
text: Reminders Reminders A gentle nudge a few evenings a week, at the time you choose. Never late at night.
